title: What is Matter?
subject: Chemistry
objective: Anything that has mass and takes up space is matter, even the air you cannot see.

fill.q: Matter is anything that has ____ and occupies space.
The SI unit of mass is ____.
The SI unit of volume is ____.

tf.explain: It has mass and fills space (a balloon).
It has no mass and does not occupy space.
They have no mass or volume.

ar.r: Air has mass and occupies space.
ar.explain: R is the definition of matter applied to air.
A is false (no mass, no volume); R is true but irrelevant.

num.q: Convert: (a) 2.5 L to mL, (b) 750 mL to L, (c) 3 dm³ to L.

short.q: How can you show that air is matter?
short.solution: An inflated balloon fills space (volume), and a full balloon weighs slightly more than an empty one (mass). So air is matter.

short.q: Classify: water, light, sand, sound, air, heat.
short.solution: Matter: water, sand, air. Not matter: light, sound, heat.

match.explain: Only things with mass and volume are matter.
